cues.zh: 你也许会觉得，这只猩猩在洗袜子，
cues.en: You might think that this orang-utan is washing socks

cues.zh: 像是专门训练过的马戏团把戏，
cues.en: as some kind of circus trick for which she's been specially trained,

cues.zh: 但并非如此。
cues.en: but not so.

cues.zh: 她完全是自发这么做的。
cues.en: She is doing this entirely on her own initiative.

cues.zh: 她看到别人这么做，就跟着模仿。
cues.en: She's seen others doing it and she's copying.

cues.zh: 而这种模仿能力，以及使用工具的能力，
cues.en: And that ability to imitate, as well as to use tools,

cues.zh: 最初起源于猴子之中，
cues.en: is something which started among monkeys,

cues.zh: 但在类人猿身上发展到了高得多的水平。
cues.en: but has been brought to a much greater level among the apes.

cues.zh: 这两项才能最终促成了世界的变革。
cues.en: Those two talents were ultimately to lead to the transformation of the world.

cues.zh: 婆罗洲的利基营是一群特殊猩猩的家园，
cues.en: Camp Leakey in Borneo is home to a special group of orangs,

cues.zh: 它们从圈养中被解救出来，重返野外。
cues.en: who have been rescued from captivity and returned to the wild.

cues.zh: 因为它们既在我们的世界里生活过，也在它们自己的世界里生活过，
cues.en: Because they've lived partly in our world as well as theirs,

cues.zh: 所以能让我们洞悉彼此的共同之处。
cues.en: they can give us an insight into what we have in common.

cues.zh: 这位老太太热爱动手DIY。
cues.en: This old lady loves DIY.

cues.zh: 她的儿子也是如此，他出生在野外。
cues.en: So does her son, who was born in the wild.

cues.zh: 连她的婴儿也很感兴趣。
cues.en: Even her infant is interested.

cues.zh: 当你这么近距离地坐在猩猩旁边时，会非常震撼
cues.en: It's very striking when you sit as close to an orang-utan as this

cues.zh: 看到它们和人类有多么相似。
cues.en: to see how similar they are to human beings.

cues.zh: 当然，我们都是大型猿类。
cues.en: We are both, of course, great apes.

cues.zh: 但看看她的手多么像人类。
cues.en: But look how human her hand is.

cues.zh: 她拿起东西的灵巧程度。
cues.en: The skill with which she picks things up.

cues.zh: 她能那样抓住工具的方式。
cues.en: The way that she can grasp a tool like that.

cues.zh: 她如何用大脑模仿她看到别人做的事。
cues.en: How she uses her brain to imitate what she's seen others doing.

cues.zh: 但我们最重要的共同点是大脑很大。
cues.en: But the most important thing we share is our big brain.

cues.zh: 正是这造就了许多天赋
cues.en: It's that that has produced so many of the talents

cues.zh: 以及我们共同拥有的能力。
cues.en: and abilities that we have in common.
